4 checks repository root, submodule gitdir, recorded/native/gitlink identities and receipt host. Already-restored state uses host checkout bytes with configured line-ending conversion. Wrong repo/host/gitlink and both-host happy/resume cases are explicit.
Assessment: The plan now states the required pre-overwrite identity and autocrlf-aware outcome. Implementation must reproduce actual Git conversion, not equate blob LF bytes with Windows checkout bytes.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Include interrupted Windows restoration with autocrlf enabled and verify copies and untouched paths before each resume.

A05 PASS [medium]: Complete execution and stable denominator. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:74.
Evidence: A05 retains selected IDs and terminal per-project TRX, requires all selected cases executed with zero skipped/aborted/not-executed, and rejects swapped failures, a missing project, discovery drift and partial runs. D2 and D5 use the same contract.
Assessment: This closes the execution-denominator gap at plan level. It exposes, rather than solves, the additional selected failure under F06.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Keep identity equality at D2 and D5; a changed known-red set, including improvement, needs an explicit disposition.

A06 PASS [medium]: Up-to-date make and evidence retention. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:73.
Evidence: Current builder lines 220-231 can replace link evidence with an empty mapping when successful make emits no link line. D1 now requires reuse only after object hashes match the receipt, or a named safe prerequisite before replacing old evidence; mock controls and real D5 All reruns on both hosts are explicit.
Assessment: The missing repeat-build outcome is now owned without treating empty stdout as usable link evidence.
Required action / acceptance outcome: The real rerun must retain original evidence and prove object/hash validation, including interrupted stage resume.

R02 PASS [medium]: Measured current-round progress timestamps. Source: response.jsonl:1.
Evidence: The first current-round progress object and subsequent progress objects were generated by PowerShell Get-Date at emission, with numeric completionPercent and etaSeconds. No placeholder time or backfilled progress object was emitted.
Assessment: The round 2 unmeasured timestamp defect was not repeated. ETA remains the reviewer report, not a deadline or a bound on the review.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Continue measured live progress through persistence and final emission.

N03 UNKNOWN [high]: R10 does not establish the broader reader-safety claim. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:56.
Evidence: Pinned drive-snapshot.c line 315 leaves rotation_table_ptr uninitialized; absent/TDE-off units bypass its assignment at 394, but line 433 unconditionally passes the array to rotation_table_set. rotation.c lines 189-203 reads each entry at 194 regardless of DriveType, then overwrites speed_zone at 203. Type NONE protects the three clock assignments, not this source read.
Assessment: The source contradicts the broad statement that no uninitialized value is read. The overwritten store may be optimized away in a particular binary; this review did not compile or execute native code and does not claim observed corruption. Executable impact and a portable safety disposition remain unproved.
Required action / acceptance outcome: Before any affected real load, D1 must resolve the entire pinned reader path and retain both-host executable/source evidence or an approved external disposition. Keep VICE immutable and the required fixture approved; do not assume three skipped assignments establish whole-reader safety.

N04 ADD-AC [medium]: D1/D5 SnapshotObserver_PreservesArchitecturalRegistersAndResult. Source: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:57.
Evidence: Pinned mos6510.h lines 116-136 splits N and Z from raw p and recomposes architectural P through MOS6510_REGS_GET_STATUS. The required fixture has P=A0. Successful read populates the globals on both machines, and the call is cross-object; the proposed seam is feasible.
Assessment: An explicit status-byte and forwarding control prevents an otherwise plausible raw-field implementation from losing flags. This strengthens the chosen R11 B design without rejecting it.
Required action / acceptance outcome: D1 mock tests must reconstruct architectural P, cover N/Z/unused-bit combinations, wide clock and PC, call the real reader exac
